description: This file defines the Cache class responsible for managing caching mechanisms within a SCSS PHP processing library. It includes methods for retrieving, storing, and managing cache files, along with configuration options for cache directory, prefix, refresh policies, and cleanup functionality.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: Manages caching for SCSS compilation results, including methods for retrieving, storing, and cleaning cache data, with configurable cache directory, prefix, and refresh policies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes cache configuration based on provided options, including setting cache directory, prefix, and refresh behavior; throws exceptions if required parameters are missing.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached data based on operation, target, options, and last modified time, considering cache refresh policies and data freshness.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Stores the result of a cacheable operation into a cache file, serialized, and updates refresh tracking if applicable.

methods.name: cacheName
methods.description: Generates a unique cache filename based on operation, target, options, and versioning, using a SHA1 hash.

methods.name: checkCacheDir
methods.description: Ensures that the cache directory exists and is writable; throws exceptions if not.

methods.name: cleanCache
methods.description: Removes outdated cache files based on lifetime; preserves recent files and those not matching cache file patterns.
